checks: Unique piece IDs and existing SVG assets
Re-derived nominal geometry matches stored geometry
Retail contents refer to existing pieces with positive whole quantities
Slotless references supply no slot model or reflection
limitations: Hybrid is reference-only in this version of the slot-track editor. Reference placement is available, but snapping, centreline / per-lane lengths, slot preview and Timing slot routes are not supplied.
Left and right are separate physical parts with directional red/blue edge markings. They are listed separately; reflecting artwork does not make the opposite physical part.

Standard straight and standard curve envelope use manufacturer dimensions. R2 dimensions use the cited independent examination. Special surfaces / accessories have incomplete footprints and remain schematic.
